consentModal.label: Cookie consent
consentModal.title: Hello traveller, it's cookie time!
consentModal.description: We use cookies to make this website work, to understand how it is used and to show you relevant ads.

sections.title: Cookie Usage
sections.description: We use cookies to make this website work and to improve your experience. You can choose which categories to allow below and change your choice at any time. For more details, read our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Strictly Necessary Cookies Always Enabled
sections.description: These cookies are essential for the website to work properly, for example to keep you signed in or to remember your cookie preferences. They cannot be disabled.

sections.title: Functionality Cookies
sections.description: These cookies remember your choices, such as your language or region, to give you a more personal experience. Disabling them may break some features.

sections.title: Analytics Cookies
sections.description: These cookies collect anonymous information about how visitors use the website, such as the pages visited and the time spent on them, so we can improve it.

sections.title: Advertisement Cookies
sections.description: These cookies are used to show you ads that are relevant to your interests and to measure how well our advertising campaigns perform.

sections.title: More information
sections.description: If you have any questions about our cookie policy or your choices, please contact us.
